title.narrative: Science Granting Council Initative phase III

description.narrative:
Science Granting Council Initiative phase 3 (SGCI-III) will strengthen national Science Granting Councils (SGCs) in 20 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. This involves strengthening the Councils' research management systems and practices to improve their capacity to organise calls, manage research grants and promote knowledge uptake. Topics for research calls will be in line with national and/or regional priorities, such as the African Union’s research strategy STISA-2034 (agriculture, health, ICT, energy, environment - including climate change adaptation). Through both national and multi-country calls, the initiative will fund research projects and contribute to increasing Africa-led research, including south-south research collaboration. SGCI-III will also mainstream gender equality and inclusivity and put special emphasis on strengthen the research capacity of female researchers and the new generation of researchers.
IMPACT: Strengthened Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) systems drive sustainable development in Sub-Saharan Africa Outcome 1: Increased production of high-quality Africa-led research and scaled innovations that address development challenges Outcome 2: Enhanced strategic leadership and STI policy influence by SGCs Outcome 3: Strengthened research and innovation management operations of SGCs
Target groups: Primary target group is SGCs in 20 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa (Angola, Botswana, Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire, Ethiopia, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, Nigeria, Rwanda, Senegal, Sierra Leone, South Africa, Tanzania, Togo, Uganda, Zambia and Zimbabwe). Other target groups include researchers in sub-Saharan Africa and potential users of research such as governments, private sector and civil society actors.
